title: You Spent a Summer in Death Valley — What Breaks First?
description:
If you spent a summer in Death Valley, what would your body face?

Sources:
- NOAA: https://www.noaa.gov/science
- U.S. Geological Survey: https://www.usgs.gov/science

Impossible Brief · Episode 7 · One impossible scenario, worked through with real science, every day.
